record.paper_title: Some Open Questions in Analysis for Dirichlet Series
record.original_question: Relate the recent estimates for GCD sums sum_{k,ℓ=1}^N (gcd(n_k,n_ℓ))^{2α}/(n_k n_ℓ)^α to the function theory and operator theory of Hardy spaces H^p of Dirichlet series.

evidence.quote: Problem 5.1. Link the estimates for GCD sums to the function and operator theory of the spaces Hp.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For real $\alpha>0$ and a finite set of distinct positive integers $n_1,\dots,n_N$, consider the GCD sum
$$S_\alpha(n_1,\dots,n_N) \;=\; \sum_{k,\ell=1}^N \frac{(\gcd(n_k,n_\ell))^{2\alpha}}{(n_k\,n_\ell)^{\alpha}}.$$
Sharp asymptotic upper bounds for the supremum of $S_\alpha$ over $N$-element subsets are known (notably for $\alpha=1/2$, where the sharp growth rate is $\exp\bigl((C+o(1))\sqrt{\log N\,\log\log\log N/\log\log N}\bigr)$, and for $\alpha\in(1/2,1)$ with corresponding extremal rates).

For $1\le p\le\infty$, let $\mathcal{H}^p$ denote the Hardy space of Dirichlet series, defined as the closure of Dirichlet polynomials $\sum_{n=1}^N a_n n^{-s}$ under the norm
$$\Bigl\|\sum a_n n^{-s}\Bigr\|_{\mathcal{H}^p} \;=\; \lim_{T\to\infty} \Bigl(\frac{1}{T}\int_0^T \Bigl|\sum a_n n^{-it}\Bigr|^p dt\Bigr)^{1/p},$$
equivalently (via the Bohr lift $z_j = p_j^{-s}$) the Hardy space $H^p(\mathbb{T}^\infty)$ of the infinite-dimensional polydisk.

Problem: Establish quantitative links between the known estimates for the GCD sums $S_\alpha$ above and the function theory and operator theory of the Hardy spaces $\mathcal{H}^p$. In particular, derive consequences for problems such as embedding inequalities, multiplier and composition operator norms, idempotent/local-norm comparisons, or Carleson-type measures on $\mathcal{H}^p$, in which the GCD-sum bounds yield sharp or improved estimates; and conversely, deduce information about $S_\alpha$ from $\mathcal{H}^p$-theoretic considerations.
artifact.category_tag: Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series and GCD sums
artifact.status_search_result: GCD-sum estimates have been used to obtain results in the function/operator theory of $\mathcal{H}^p$ spaces of Dirichlet series — notably in work of Aistleitner–Berkes–Seip and subsequent papers connecting GCD sums to Carleson measures, multiplicative chaos, embedding inequalities, and composition/Volterra operators on $\mathcal{H}^p$. While many concrete links have been established, the broader programmatic problem of fully linking sharp GCD-sum asymptotics to the function and operator theory of $\mathcal{H}^p$ remains an active area with open aspects.

status_evidence.title: Multipliers for Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizes the space of multipliers from H_p into H_q for 1 ≤ p,q ≤ ∞ on Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series.
status_evidence.claim: Active research links analytic/operator properties of $\mathcal{H}^p$ to number-theoretic sums.

status_evidence.title: H_p-Theory of General Dirichlet Series
status_evidence.snippet: Develops the H_p theory of general Dirichlet series and uses Bohr lift connections.
status_evidence.claim: Framework in which GCD-sum estimates can be deployed.

status_evidence.title: Volterra operators on Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series
status_evidence.snippet: Studies symbols g such that T_g: H^p -> H^p is bounded on Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series.
status_evidence.claim: Operator-theoretic results on $\mathcal{H}^p$ continue to be developed, with partial connections to GCD-type estimates.
